domainContext.context: IEEE VIS是可视化领域的顶级国际会议，需要一套完整的宣传视觉系统。设计应体现学术专业性，同时具有现代感和视觉冲击力。极简几何与大胆排版风格需要平衡信息传达与美学表现，确保在不同尺寸和媒介上保持一致的品牌识别。

summary: Research complete: 10 usable assets (2 logos, 3 protected, 0 flagged). IEEE VIS 2026 confirmed: Nov 9-13, Boston Park Plaza Hotel. Official logos are SVG-only (rasterization rejected by tool — use official SVG files directly in production). Swiss/International style precedents downloaded. Mode: extension.
requestedAction: Proceed to PLAN. Key notes: (1) Official logos are SVG — Designer should reference the official SVG files from ieeevis.org/year/2026/assets/ rather than the rasterized versions. (2) 5 open questions in evidence.json (color palette flexibility, specific theme/tagline, mandatory elements, poster display context, animated social media). (3) Design direction: Swiss/International style + data visualization aesthetics, dark backgrounds with bright accents, modular grid system scaling from A2 to social to badge to PPT.
